title: Show weather description with temperature in non-system-tray representation
line: The Weather Report widget in a panel can now show the current conditions, like "Overcast", below the temperature.
explanation: The weather widget's compact view could only show the temperature beside or over its icon; the condition text (sunny, rainy…) was only in the tooltip. Nate agreed it's fine to show it when the widget is not in the System Tray. The change adds a "Show current conditions below the temperature" option (off by default) under "Show temperature: Beside the widget icon"; when on, the temperature and the provider's condition text are stacked in two lines next to the icon in horizontal panels, sized like the digital clock's time and date.

commits.message:
applets/weather: show current conditions below the temperature

Outside the System Tray, the widget could only show the temperature next
to its icon, so seeing if it's sunny or rainy needed a hover. Add an
option to stack the current conditions below the temperature in panels.

BUG: 457306

patches.diff:
From 1fc2291dee755c3781f9a58e9ed0116355414ff7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:36:07 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: show current conditions below the
 temperature

Outside the System Tray, the widget could only show the temperature next
to its icon, so seeing if it's sunny or rainy needed a hover. Add an
option to stack the current conditions below the temperature in panels.

BUG: 457306
---
 applets/weather/main.xml                      |  3 ++
 applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml |  2 +
 applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml       | 49 +++++++++++++++++--
 .../weather/qml/config/ConfigAppearance.qml   |  8 +++
 4 files changed, 58 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/weather/main.xml b/applets/weather/main.xml
index 0bf4efa0f..1841849ee 100644
--- a/applets/weather/main.xml
+++ b/applets/weather/main.xml
@@ -34,6 +34,9 @@ SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
     <entry name="showTemperatureInBadge" type="bool">
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="showConditionsInCompactMode" type="bool">
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
 
     <entry name="showTemperatureInTooltip" type="bool">
       <default>true</default>
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
index c66ae91a7..8d2962ae1 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -26,6 +26,7 @@ Loader {
 
     readonly property bool vertical: Plasmoid.formFactor == PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
     readonly property bool showTemperature: Plasmoid.configuration.showTemperatureInCompactMode
+    readonly property bool showConditions: Plasmoid.configuration.showConditionsInCompactMode && !compactRoot.vertical
 
     readonly property bool needsToBeSquare: (Plasmoid.containmentType & PlasmaCore.Types.CustomEmbeddedContainment)
         || (Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentForcesSquarePlasmoids)
@@ -99,6 +100,7 @@ Loader {
             fallback: Util.unknownWeatherIcon
             active: compactMouseArea.containsMouse
             text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : "";
+            subText: compactRoot.showConditions ? (compactRoot.lastObservation?.currentConditions ?? "") : ""
         }
     }
 }
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml b/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml
index 684c9d4b6..2de8bc96a 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml
@@ -16,12 +16,14 @@ GridLayout {
 
     property alias iconSource: icon.source
     property alias text: label.text
+    property alias subText: subLabel.text
     property alias fallback: icon.fallback
     property bool vertical: false // too bad we cannot make this an enum
     property alias active: icon.active
 
     readonly property int minimumIconSize: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small
     readonly property int iconSize: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? width : height
+    readonly property bool hasSubText: !iconAndTextRoot.vertical && subLabel.text.length > 0
 
     columns: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? 1 : 2
     rows: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? 2 : 1
@@ -51,7 +53,7 @@ GridLayout {
 
         Layout.fillWidth: iconAndTextRoot.vertical
         Layout.fillHeight: !iconAndTextRoot.vertical
-        Layout.minimumWidth: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? 0 : sizehelper.paintedWidth
+        Layout.minimumWidth: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? 0 : Math.max(sizehelper.paintedWidth, iconAndTextRoot.hasSubText ? subSizehelper.paintedWidth : 0)
         Layout.maximumWidth: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? Infinity : Layout.minimumWidth
 
         Layout.minimumHeight: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? sizehelper.paintedHeight : 0
@@ -80,7 +82,7 @@ GridLayout {
             // text sizes here are identical with various clock text sizes
             height: {
                 const textHeightScaleFactor = (parent.height > 26) ? 0.7 : 0.9;
-                return Math.min (parent.height * textHeightScaleFactor, 3 * Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize);
+                return Math.min (parent.height * textHeightScaleFactor, 3 * Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize) / (iconAndTextRoot.hasSubText ? 2 : 1);
             }
             visible: false
 
@@ -89,6 +91,20 @@ GridLayout {
             textFormat: Text.PlainText
         }
 
+        Text {
+            id: subSizehelper
+
+            font: sizehelper.font
+            minimumPixelSize: sizehelper.minimumPixelSize
+            fontSizeMode: Text.VerticalFit
+            wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
+            height: sizehelper.height
+            visible: false
+
+            text: subLabel.text
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+        }
+
         PlasmaComponents.Label {
             id: label
 
@@ -101,12 +117,37 @@ GridLayout {
             textFormat: Text.PlainText
             wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
 
-            height: 0
+            height: iconAndTextRoot.hasSubText ? sizehelper.height : parent.height
             width: 0
             verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
             horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
             anchors {
-                fill: parent
+                left: parent.left
+                right: parent.right
+                verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
+                verticalCenterOffset: iconAndTextRoot.hasSubText ? -height / 2 : 0
+                leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+                rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+            }
+        }
+
+        PlasmaComponents.Label {
+            id: subLabel
+
+            visible: iconAndTextRoot.hasSubText
+            font: label.font
+            minimumPixelSize: label.minimumPixelSize
+            fontSizeMode: Text.Fit
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+            wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
+
+            height: sizehelper.height
+            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
+            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
+            anchors {
+                left: parent.left
+                right: parent.right
+                top: parent.verticalCenter
                 leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                 rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
             }
diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 88b1b45a7..dc8fde25b 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/config/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -21,6 +21,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
     property bool cfg_showTemperatureInCompactMode
     property bool cfg_showTemperatureInBadge
+    property alias cfg_showConditionsInCompactMode: showConditionsInCompactModeCheckBox.checked
 
     property alias cfg_showTemperatureInTooltip: showTemperatureInTooltipCheckBox.checked
     property alias cfg_showWindInTooltip: showWindInTooltipCheckBox.checked
@@ -82,6 +83,13 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                 text: i18nc("@option:radio Show temperature:", "Do not show")
             }
 
+            QQC2.CheckBox {
+                id: showConditionsInCompactModeCheckBox
+                visible: radioTempBesideIcon.visible && Plasmoid.formFactor !== PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
+                enabled: radioTempBesideIcon.checked
+                text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show current conditions below the temperature")
+            }
+
             Item {
                 Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
                 visible: root.isInPanel
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Weather widget in the bottom panel on master: only the icon and 53°F
With the option on: 53°F with "overcast" stacked below it
Appearance settings on master: no option for the conditions
New "Show current conditions below the temperature" checkbox, enabled only with "Beside the widget icon"
